name: bld4_pisano_lucas_dvd_four_mul
informal: Uses Mathlib2.an_cassini_int, Mathlib2.lib_fib_period_iff and Mathlib2.bld3_pisano_dvd_of_period: modulo L_n = F_{n+1} + F_{n−1} one has F_{2n} = F_n L_n ≡ 0 and F_{2n+1} = F_{n+1}^2 + F_n^2 ≡ F_n^2 − F_{n+1}F_{n−1} = ±1 by an_cassini_int. Hence F_{4n} ≡ 0 and F_{4n+1} ≡ F_{2n+1}^2 ≡ 1, so lib_fib_period_iff makes 4n a period mod L_n and bld3_pisano_dvd_of_period concludes (n = 0 trivial).
